display.purpose: The home hero H1 only. Archivo, width 75, weight 700.

title.purpose: Card and row titles, one step below Headline. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, 20px.

body.purpose: Prose and general UI text. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, 17px, line height 1.55.

figure.purpose: Big stat numbers. Archivo with tabular figures.

label.purpose: Synced numbers and timestamps only. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono marks a value as machine-sourced; it is not used for labels. Informational text never drops below --fs-meta (15px).

shadows.name: keycap-primary
shadows.purpose: The solid edge under the primary button. Compresses to 0 1px 0 on :active.

shadows.name: keycap-ghost
shadows.purpose: The solid edge under the ghost button (light theme: #a497b9). Compresses to 0 1px 0 on :active.

shadows.name: anchor
shadows.purpose: Floating things only (modal, settings popover), light theme. Dark has no shadow: elevation is the surface step.

shadows.name: glow-live
shadows.purpose: The live dot's halo, the only glow in the system (light theme: rgba(125,51,194,.4)).

motion.name: dur-pulse
motion.purpose: The live and fresh-sync dot pulse, the only looping animation.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for press and release.

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark room lit by a violet LED shelf. The room is purple: an aubergine ground, violet-tinted lines, lavender text, so nothing on the page is gray. Everything is one hue, OKLCH 303 (amethyst, a step toward magenta from the template-default indigo-violet at 293), spent in three tiers of intensity. The room (surfaces and lines, chroma about 0.05) is flat steps with no gradient. Data and structure (the heat ramp and muted text, chroma 0.04 to 0.14) are the mid violets. The signal (the live tokens, chroma 0.16 to 0.21) is the LED: the brightest violet on the page, and it means one thing, something is happening right now. Imported colour (language colours, game and album art) is the only other hue and lands harder against a violet ground than against gray.

The feel is warm, plain, and personal, with precise numbers underneath. It is one person's homepage that updates itself, not a marketing surface. Type is Archivo (display, with the width axis for long German words and big figures), Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (body and UI, built for scanning stats and lists), and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for synced numbers only, so a mono value reads as synced without a label.

Controls are tactile: both buttons are keycaps that press into a solid edge. Elevation on dark is a surface step plus a hairline, never a shadow or a glow; light theme keeps shadows for floating things only. The contribution heat ramp is neutral-to-violet and quiet, and only today is the signal, so a commit landing today is readable at a glance. The site has no live strip: a 28 day activity strip was built and dropped in review because it had no reason to sit in the header and its meaning was unclear without hovering. Life uses three forms, each once: a cover wall of art tiles, a typographic list, and a Wrapped poster. A Featured lead with no image of its own is a typographic card.
keyCharacteristics: One violet world at hue 303 in three tiers: room, data, signal. No gray ground, no gray text.
The brightest violet means now, and only now: live data, the one primary action, the focus ring.
Colour is imported, not invented. Violet is the only colour the palette owns, plus red for errors.
Elevation is a surface step on dark and a border on light; shadows only for floating things in light, the keycap edge on buttons, and one glow on the live dot.
Freshness is a rendered state, and motion has a reason (the keycap press, the live pulse, a panel fade on state change) or it does not ship.

rules.name: The Room Is Violet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces, lines, ink and the data ramp all carry hue 303. A new neutral is a violet at low chroma, never a true gray.

rules.name: The Signal Means Now Rule
rules.body: The brightest violet (live, live-ink, live-solid) has three jobs: live or just-happened data including the today cell, the one primary action per view, and the focus ring. Not a selected tab, an active toggle, or a data series. Selected states use ink-strong versus muted, never the signal hue. The lint:design check holds the signal tokens to a per-file allowance.

rules.name: The Imported Colour Rule
rules.body: Violet is the only colour this palette invents. Language colours, game and album art, and vendor brand marks (Spotify, YouTube, Twitch, Discord status) come from real data and are never retuned. Red appears only as the error state.

rules.name: The Control Boundary Rule
rules.body: A control whose border is its only edge uses the control line (3:1 or better), never the decorative hairline.

rules.name: The Three Faces Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries the wordmark, headings, and big figures. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next carries body and UI. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is for synced numbers and timestamps only, not for labels. --fs-meta is 15px, the floor for informational text. No uppercase letter-spaced labels on the public site.

rules.name: The One-Anchor Rule
rules.body: Surface Three appears at most once per page. Cards are never nested, and at most two ModuleCards appear on a page.

rules.name: The Flat Steps Rule
rules.body: Depth is a surface step plus a hairline on dark and a border on light. No gradient wash, no glass or blur, and no glow except the live dot.

rules.name: The Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Interactive targets are at least 24px for a pointer and 44px for a coarse pointer. Tabs, the wordmark link, and the theme toggle are 44px tall.

rules.name: The No Pills Rule
rules.body: Radius is by role: 4px chips, tags and heat cells; 6px buttons, inputs and images; 10px cards, the presence widget and the modal. Fully round only for avatars, the live dot, and the settings switch.

dos: Do use the signal violet for live data, the one primary action per view, and the focus ring, and build everything else from the room and data violets.
Do express elevation as a surface step on dark and reserve shadows for floating things on light.
Do render a synced module's real freshness state (fresh, stale, empty, failed, never).
Do source colour from real data wherever the page has real data, and use tokens for every size, radius, and colour.
Do vary layout families between pages and sections: Life uses a cover wall, a typographic list, and a Wrapped poster, and a Featured lead without its own image is a typographic card.
donts: Don't use the signal violet for a selected tab, an active toggle, or a data series. The heat ramp is the data violet.
Don't fake depth with a glow, a gradient wash, or a coloured bloom.
Don't use mono for labels, or set informational text below 15px.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels, middle-dot meta strings, or arrows on link text.
Don't add a site-wide live strip, animate on scroll, or invent a palette colour that cannot be sourced from data or the existing scale.
